title: Bench schema
description: A long seat for several people, typically outdoors in a park, square, street or along a path, available for use by the general public. Extends the Smart Data Models PointOfInterest. Boolean properties follow a tri-state convention: omitted means unknown, false means known to be absent.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be Bench

backrest.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench has a backrest. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM backrest

armrest.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench has armrests, at the ends or between seats. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM armrest

seats.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of people who can sit on the bench at the same time. Source: OSM seats

seatsSeparated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the seats are separated from each other, e.g. by armrests or dividers, so the bench can't be lain on. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM seats:separated

material.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Main material of the seat. Enum:'wood, metal, steel, concrete, stone, granite, plastic'. Source: OSM material

direction.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Direction a seated person faces, in degrees clockwise from north. For a two-sided bench, either side. Units:'degrees'. Source: OSM direction

twoSided.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether people can sit on both sides of the bench. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM two_sided

lyingDown.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench is suitable for lying down on. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM lying_down

hostileArchitecture.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Design features that discourage lying or lingering on the bench. Enum:'slanted, separatedSeats, spikes, other'. Source: OSM hostile_architecture

covered.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench is under a roof or shelter. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM covered

lit.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench is lit at night. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM lit

wasteBasket.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether a waste basket is attached to or right next to the bench. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM bin

inscription.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Text engraved on or attached to the bench, such as a memorial plaque. Source: OSM inscription

memorial.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Boolean'. Whether the bench is a memorial bench, dedicated to a person or event. Omitted means unknown; false means known to be absent. Source: OSM memorial=bench

level.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Floor level where the bench is located, 0 being ground level. Only relevant indoors or in multi-level structures. Source: OSM level

checkDate.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Date'. Date the bench was last verified to exist and match its description on the ground. Source: OSM check_date, survey:date
